verdict.rationale: Martin documents a set of autonomous background tasks: cc-to-schedule meeting coordination, proactive email drafts, email triage with follow-up actions, and scheduled briefings. It also offers custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions, and a community user reports it handling complicated requests correctly. However, these are fixed task types, not open-ended delegation of an arbitrary multi-step job, and the docs are one-line descriptions that never describe a step where finished work is returned for the user's review. Missing for 10: general-purpose delegation of arbitrary multi-step tasks, a documented review/approval step before results are finalized, progress tracking, in-depth docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of background task execution.
